subject.title: Grossmont Union High School District Board, Trustee Area 3

text: Every student gets one chance at a great education. I am running to ensure Grossmont Union High School District puts students, classrooms, and responsible stewardship first.

I have dedicated nearly 30 years to public education, including 15 years serving GUHSD students and families as a counselor, assistant principal, and district administrator. I later served as a principal, associate superintendent, and deputy superintendent supporting 23 school districts and overseeing more than $65 million in public funds.

As your Trustee, I will work to restore safe, supportive schools and essential student services; protect strong academics, career technical education, arts, athletics, and pathways to college, careers, trades, or military service; put classroom needs first; demand transparent, accountable use of taxpayer dollars; and ensure parents, educators, students, and our community are heard before major decisions are made.
East County is my home. I attended GUHSD schools, as did my husband and daughters. Today, my daughters teach in local public schools, and I am a proud grandmother.
I am honored to be endorsed by the Grossmont Education Association and El Cajon Police Officers’ Association.
I will bring experienced, independent, student-centered leadership to every decision.
Please vote Jeneé Littrell for Grossmont Union High School District Board of Trustees!

text: “Strong academics, no politics.” As a teacher and President of the Grossmont Union High School District Governing Board, I have been instrumental in the ongoing transformation that is making Grossmont one of the most advanced, award-winning districts in California.

Successfully launched high-paying AI-empowered career pathways in aerospace, biotechnology, business, construction, cybersecurity, drones, engineering, finances, medicine, nursing, robotics, and solar. Students deserve a world-class education.
Secured a billion dollars, including matching federal/state grants, to modernize classrooms – constructing state-of-the-art science labs, sports facilities, and theaters.

Reduced waste and inefficiency, eliminating dozens of overpriced, outdated positions, and returning $27 million to East County taxpayers making housing more affordable, while expanding mental health and career-technical education aligned with our Portrait of a Graduate vision.

World-class recognitions: “Dr. Gary Woods, San Diego County School Board Member of the Year.” U.S. Department of Education, Forbes, U.S. News & World Report, NICHE School Ratings, and San Diego Taxpayers Association have recognized Grossmont Union High School District for excellence, innovation, green energy, and transparency.
Implemented “Dual Enrollment” allowing students to take college courses while in high school, saving parents thousands of dollars.

Recognized/supported/endorsed by East County teachers, coaches, parents, police, business leaders, and elected officials, I fight for community values, fiscal responsibility, transparency, student safety, and preparing every student for ethical leadership in tomorrow’s workforce.
